cv_sections.summary:
I have a bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication
engineering. I worked for academia and multiple reputed IT firms in
areas such as Predictive models, NLP(including Generative AI and
Large Language Models), Speech Recognition etc. While working in
different challenging assignments all these years (14+), I applied my
knowledge and judgement to achieve project goals. 
I am experienced in solving business problems across domains and
building useful products through Machine Learning, Deep Learning
algorithms. I do code in Python.
I directly manage a team of Data Scientists and often work with
the team in various assignments involving state-of-the-art Machine
Learning techniques.
I get excited to hear about futuristic technologies and environmental
sustainability measures.
